changes.title: Functional suggestion dividers
changes.detail: Restore the Chrome accessory divider and ordinary prediction/punctuation dividers with their previous theme-aware styling. Keep the two unwanted outer paste-strip bars absent. Confidence-mode behavior, compact geometry, actions and clipboard privacy remain unchanged.

changes.title: Contextual action slot
changes.detail: Fresh unambiguous copies can reveal dialer, email, Maps or whitespace-cleaned paste in the same animated slot. Explicit taps only; original paste, Chrome, provider actions and privacy controls retained.

changes.title: More contextual clipboard actions
changes.detail: Long-press Chrome to copy a cleaned link; long-press phone or email to open the contact editor. Fresh ISO dates open an all-day calendar draft, recognizable UPS codes open the carrier tracking page, copied all-caps prose can paste in sentence case, and mixed text can open a masked entity picker. All actions require explicit user interaction.
